_how: Test set for comment and DM replies. 'want' is the right send decision (true, false or either). 'route' is what the n8n code should do before the AI: ai, pool (praise list), hidden (spam/abuse filter) or filtered (prompt-injection guard). 'ref' is a reference reply written by Claude, used only for grading, never shown to the local model. c-real and d-real rows are anonymized copies of real Inbox rows.
